policy.vendoring: No upstream source is committed to this repository. Files are pinned by upstream commit plus content hash and fetched on demand by research/external/pin_upstream.py. Two projects are GPL-3.0 and three carry no license at all; committing either class here would be a license incorporation decision that no directive has authorised.
policy.transport: raw.githubusercontent.com. The sandbox egress policy answers 403 to github.com and codeload.github.com, so git clone and tarball download are both unavailable. Fetching a single blob at a pinned commit is also the narrower operation.
policy.commit_selection: Every commit here was fixed by the owner's addendum before any Trading Lab OS result existed for these candidates. Directive v1.1 section 7 forbids selecting a favourable upstream commit after seeing our own result; re-pinning to a different commit therefore requires a new candidate ID.
policy.digests: sha256 is the identity used by the gate. git_blob_sha1 is sha1(b'blob <len>\u00000' + bytes) - the value GitHub shows in its UI - recorded so a pin can be checked against what a human read without downloading anything.

license.note: Benchmarking GPL code does not require making it a core dependency (directive v1.1 section 18). Fetched at run time, never committed.
